subject.title: [Feature]: Optimization for Dockerfile.sandbox-common # add retries and fix-missings for apt-get

question: Should sandbox Dockerfile installs accept `--fix-missing` partial-install semantics, or should this fix be retry-only?
rationale: `Acquire::Retries` addresses transient fetch failures, while `--fix-missing` can change the image completeness contract by holding back unavailable packages.

options.title: Use retry-only APT installs
options.body: Keep `Acquire::Retries=5` on the affected update/install commands and remove `--fix-missing` so required sandbox packages still fail closed after retries.

options.title: Accept partial-install behavior
options.body: Keep `--fix-missing` only if maintainers explicitly want that behavior and add package-presence verification or documentation for the resulting contract.

options.title: Replace the current PR
options.body: If the current branch is not revised and proven, close or supersede it with a narrower retry-only PR.

recommendation.title: Use retry-only APT installs
recommendation.body: Keep `Acquire::Retries=5` on the affected update/install commands and remove `--fix-missing` so required sandbox packages still fail closed after retries.
